prompt_head:
Job: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
- (required) Professional experience building and deploying production-grad

output.angle: Position Tylor as a hands-on AI agent builder who has shipped LangGraph agents with human approval, tracing, and eval gates, and who can translate that into customer-facing deployment work.
posting_hooks: Hands-on production agent work: Job Fit Agent is a LangGraph agent with RAG on pgvector and a human approval step, deployed with FastAPI, Postgres, and Docker.
Evaluation and observability: an eval suite with record/replay gates in CI, plus Langfuse tracing and a daily cost cap on the live agent.
Customer-facing onboarding: designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to onboard high-value enterprise clients.
